subject: Novak Health POC: kickoff scheduling, success criteria & weekly cadence
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Ng <claire.ng@novakhealth.com>, Alan Kelly <alan.kelly@novakhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:14:00 -0700
Subject: Novak Health POC discovery — recap & proposed next steps

Thanks Claire and Alan — great conversation today. Quick recap and proposed timeline so we can lock dates and owners.

Call highlights (from our side)
- Goal: validate Redwood Inference for real-time clinical note summarization and semantic search across Novak patient records; primary success metric is production-quality summary accuracy and end-to-end latency.
- Data: Novak will provide a representative test set (~20k notes) and a small labeled subset for eval.
- Constraints: data residency in US region, standard SOC2 controls required, no PHI stored outside customer-managed storage during pilot.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm or edit)
1) Functional: extractive+abstractive summaries with ROUGE-L >= 0.45 on Novak labeled subset (or equivalent precision/recall targets)
2) Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end inference latency < 300ms for 1k-token requests on dedicated instance profile
3) Throughput/stability: sustain 20 QPS for 30-minute window without errors and 99% availability during test windows
4) Operational: infra and logging in place (audit logs, KV cache clearing, key management) and an agreed rollback/fallback policy

Proposed timeline & cadence
- Kickoff workshop (technical + procurement): week of Apr 12 — propose Mon Apr 12, 10:00 PT (30–60m)
- Pilot duration: 3 weeks (two evaluation windows: week 2 and final readout in week 3)
- Weekly syncs: 45 mins, Tuesdays 10:00 PT (we can adjust to your preference)
- Final readout: Fri Apr 30 (demo + data-driven verdict)

Owners (initial)
- Redwood sales: Soojin Lee — overall coordination, contract/procurement liaison
- Redwood SE: Marissa Cole — runbook, test harness, and technical lead for validation
- Redwood CS: Marcus Lin — success criteria instrumenting and post-pilot onboarding planning
- Novak technical lead: Claire Ng — dataset, test access, and stakeholder engagement

Next steps / asks
- Claire/Alan: please confirm the success criteria above, preferred kickoff date/time, and point of contact for procurement (if not Alan).
- Novak: provide the representative test set and a short list of top 10 queries/use-cases to prioritize in week 1.
- Redwood: we will send an initial POC plan (attached) and a pre-kickoff checklist.

Attachments: Novak_POC_plan_v1.pdf (POC milestones + runbook stub)

Thanks — happy to iterate.

—
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Claire Ng <claire.ng@novakhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alan Kelly <alan.kelly@novakhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novak Health POC: kickoff scheduling, success criteria & weekly cadence

Thanks Soojin — that looks good and aligns with our needs. A few clarifications and small edits to success criteria:
- Metrics: instead of ROUGE-L we'll provide a small clinician-evaluated pass/fail set (n=200) for human acceptability; we want >= 80% clinician pass rate on critical summaries. Please include this as a primary quality check in addition to automated metrics.
- Latency: target is fine, but worth calling out cold-start for KV cache; can you confirm expected warm vs cold 95th?
- Data: Novak can host the test set in our AWS account (us-west-2). We'll grant a read-only role for the pilot. No data leaves Novak-managed storage.

Timing: we can do Tue Apr 13 or Mon Apr 12 for kickoff; Alan prefers Apr 12 morning. Weekly syncs are easier for our operations team on Wednesdays 10:00 PT — can you adapt?

Procurement: Alan is procurement lead (alan.kelly@novakhealth.com). He'll need the SOW + a short summary of security controls to run through our vendor intake.

I've attached the labeled test set sample (Novak_testset_v1.csv) and a one-page acceptance checklist.

Claire Ng
Head of Clinical Data Platform | Novak Health
claire.ng@novakhealth.com

Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 17:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Novak Health POC: kickoff scheduling, success criteria & weekly cadence

Thanks Claire — good call. Quick technical mapping to make the acceptance criteria actionable from the runbook side:
- Quality validation: we'll run automated ROUGE and BERTScore for an initial signal, then ship the 200 clinician pass/fail items into our eval dashboard for manual review (we'll provide a simple UI for labeling). Owner: Marissa (SE).
- Latency: warm 95p target <300ms; expected cold 95p (~first request per container) ~600ms. We'll instrument warmup hooks and share a short warmup script with your infra team. Owner: Marcus (CS) + Marissa.
- Throughput: we'll stage a brief 30m soak test at 20 QPS during week 2; SE will coordinate test windows.
- Security/compliance: we'll provide a vendor security one-pager and link to our SOC2 summary for procurement.

Confirmed schedule (per Novak preference):
- Kickoff: Mon Apr 12, 10:00 PT — 45m agenda (intro, infra & data access, runbook walkthrough, immediate next actions)
- Weekly sync: Wednesdays 10:00 PT (30–45m) — technical progress + blockers
- Soak test window: week of Apr 19 (exact date TBC)
- Final readout: Fri Apr 30, 11:00 PT — demo + data + recommendation

Pre-kickoff deliverables from Redwood (will send by Mon Apr 5):
- Detailed runbook (redwood_runbook_v1.md)
- Test harness and quickstart (link + small artifact)
- Security one-pager and SOW draft

Attachments for reference: redwood_runbook_v1.md (runbook stub)

Perfect — thanks for the quick turn, Claire. Confirming the finalized plan below and listing immediate action items so procurement and engineering can act: 

Finalized success criteria (agreed)
- Clinician pass rate (primary): >= 80% on Novak clinician-eval set (n=200)
- Automated signal: ROUGE-L >= 0.45 and BERTScore threshold (for early iterations)
- Latency: warm 95p < 300ms; note cold 95p expected ~600ms (we'll document warmup)
- Stability: sustain 20 QPS during soak window with <1% error rate

Confirmed schedule
- Kickoff: Mon Apr 12, 10:00 PT — invite to follow (we'll send calendar + agenda)
- Weekly syncs: Wednesdays 10:00 PT (30–45m)
- Soak test: week of Apr 19 (Marissa will propose exact day/time)
- Final readout: Fri Apr 30, 11:00 PT

Immediate asks (owners & due dates)
- Novak (Claire): share full test set and list of top 10 queries by Mon Apr 5 (ACTION: Claire)
- Novak (Alan): procurement to confirm SOW acceptance window and any additional vendor evidence required by Mon Apr 5 (ACTION: Alan)
- Redwood (Marissa): send runbook + test harness link by Mon Apr 5 (ACTION: Marissa)
- Redwood (Marcus): instrument monitoring & alerting for soak test by Apr 16 (ACTION: Marcus)

We'll attach the POC plan and SOW draft in the calendar invite. If anyone needs a different kickoff time, flag here by EOD Monday. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
